criteria.description: The actual prompts prepare separate reusable traveler, handled rectangular lamp and shaft-space assets, retaining the left pack, coat and lamp bars but reconstructing plausible grip and connected walkway. Merely saying “design” while prescribing panel crop/cleanup/outpaint fails. Unseen rear structure is labeled proposed adaptation.

Source page, reusable design sheets and shot frames remain distinct. Portrait, square, multi-view and detail arrangements are eligible for design sheets; only shot frames inherit 16:9. The response does not mark a portrait design deficient merely for its ratio.

All SH01–SH03 critical character states, lamp/grip and connected shaft requirements are accounted for. Technical readability or metadata does not prove design acceptance. Concrete visual checks and downstream frame dependencies prevent premature video handoff.

Independent inputs are separate batch items, not a combined prompt. Missing crop-only tooling does not block admitted design generation/edit preparation. The response remains preparation only, retains stable real sources and does not claim generated results or creator approval.

Actual asset prompts implement the brief's stylized 3D volumes, resolved materials and coherent cool ambient/warm lamp lighting rather than preserving source hatching. Retain source identity and structure; do not claim source artwork already has the target look. Structural sketches remain structural only, not finished assets.

Prepare explicit traveler side/back and relevant identity views, lamp construction and carried/raised lit states, with separate view/state prompts and shared coat, left pack, lamp bars, proportions and materials. Define the anchor before dependent views and separate independent entities. Unseen rear design is proposed adaptation. A view list is not completed imagery; a turnaround is not a video first frame. Do not require irrelevant complete view sets.
